idea-plugin.name: HTML Cell Viewer
idea-plugin.description:
Preview and inspect rendered HTML content directly from database table cells in your IDE.

Features

  • Context Menu Preview: Right-click any database cell containing HTML and select View Rendered HTML (or press Ctrl+Alt+H / Option+Shift+H).
  • Chromium-Powered Rendering: Uses Chromium Embedded Framework (JCEF) for modern HTML5, CSS3, SVG, images, tables, and formatting.
  • Strict Security: Blocks arbitrary script execution via Content Security Policy and prevents link navigation while preserving link hover hand cursors.
  • Dual View: Toggle between the interactive rendered preview and formatted raw HTML source code.
  • Toolbar Controls: Copy raw HTML to clipboard or open directly in your external default web browser.

Getting Started

  1. Open a database table or execute a SQL query returning HTML data.
  2. Right-click on any cell containing HTML markup.
  3. Select View Rendered HTML (or press Ctrl+Alt+H / Option+Shift+H).
  4. Inspect the rendered result or switch tabs to view the raw HTML source code.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
1.0.0

  • Initial release of HTML Cell Viewer.
  • Render database cell HTML content via Chromium JCEF with Swing fallback.
  • Context menu integration in query result tables (Console.TableResult.PopupGroup) and keyboard shortcut Ctrl+Alt+H / Option+Shift+H.
  • Smart HTML detection filtering for cell context menus.
  • Strict Content Security Policy (CSP) blocking untrusted scripts.
  • Links show hover hand cursor while preventing accidental navigation.
  • Dual tabbed preview for rendered web output and raw HTML source.
  • Export utilities: Copy raw HTML to clipboard and open in external browser.

action.description: Renders the HTML content of the selected database cell in a browser viewer
